name: Displaced-worker cohort pool (monthly inflow/outflow)
description: A time-stepping cohort/flow model, monthly: a pool of displaced workers gets a monthly inflow from an exogenous displacement input and a monthly outflow at a re-employment rate, like the simulator's macro block. Unemployment is the natural rate plus the pool expressed as a share of the workforce. A second variable reads the pool two months back to show a lag of depth 2 with declared history.
scope: Illustrative cohort/flow toy. The displacement path, the re-employment rate and the natural rate are guesses chosen to make the pool visibly build up, then settle toward a steady state once the displacement input stops changing. Not a calibrated labor-market forecast.
